manifest.name: Abuse Goblin
manifest.summary: Hit the Goblin Tinkerer with any weapon to lower his reforge prices.

localizedSummaries.zh-Hans: 用任意武器攻击哥布林工匠，降低他的重铸价格。

manifest.name: Atmospheric Torches
manifest.summary: This mod simply adds an orange tint to normal torches and tiki torches, with their placed tiles and biome torches getting a slight flicker for atmosphere.

localizedSummaries.zh-Hans: 为普通火把和提基火把增添橙色光晕，并让放置后的火把及生物群系火把轻微闪烁。

manifest.name: Begone, Evil! (Disable Evil Biome Spread)

authors.name: Mantovani
authors.role: Bunny Loader 移植、修复与优化

manifest.summary: Disables natural Corruption, Crimson and Hallow biome spread by default, with a per-world /spread toggle.

localizedSummaries.zh-Hans: 默认阻止腐化、猩红与神圣之地自然蔓延，可使用 /spread 为每个世界单独切换。

manifest.name: Bestiary Displays
manifest.summary: Hologram Projectors that show any unlocked Bestiary creature as an animated, configurable hologram.

localizedSummaries.zh-Hans: 用全息投影仪展示图鉴中已解锁的生物，支持动画和多种显示设置。

manifest.name: Better Reforge
manifest.summary: Replaces the traditional Goblin Tinkerer interface with a new system that allows you to browse and select item prefixes directly.

localizedSummaries.zh-Hans: 替换哥布林工匠的传统重铸界面，让你直接浏览和选择物品修饰语。

manifest.name: Boss Checklist
manifest.summary: A Boss Log book with every boss, mini-boss and event: progress checklist, spawn items and recipes, loot and collectibles, fight records, despawn messages and a boss radar.

localizedSummaries.pt-BR: Um Boss Log com todos os chefes, minichefes e eventos: lista de progresso, itens de invocação e receitas, drops e colecionáveis, recordes de luta, mensagens de fuga e um radar de chefes.
localizedSummaries.es-ES: Un Boss Log con todos los jefes, minijefes y eventos: lista de progreso, objetos de invocación y recetas, botín y coleccionables, récords de combate, mensajes de huida y un radar de jefes.
localizedSummaries.de-DE: Ein Boss Log mit allen Bossen, Mini-Bossen und Ereignissen: Fortschrittsliste, Beschwörungsgegenstände und Rezepte, Beute und Sammelobjekte, Kampfrekorde, Abzugsmeldungen und ein Boss-Radar.
localizedSummaries.fr-FR: Un Boss Log avec tous les boss, mini-boss et événements : liste de progression, objets d'invocation et recettes, butin et objets de collection, records de combat, messages de départ et un radar de boss.
localizedSummaries.it-IT: Un Boss Log con tutti i boss, i mini-boss e gli eventi: lista dei progressi, oggetti di evocazione e ricette, bottino e collezionabili, record dei combattimenti, messaggi di fuga e un radar dei boss.
localizedSummaries.ru-RU: Boss Log со всеми боссами, мини-боссами и событиями: список прогресса, предметы призыва и рецепты, добыча и коллекция, рекорды боёв, сообщения об уходе и радар боссов.
localizedSummaries.pl-PL: Boss Log ze wszystkimi bossami, mini-bossami i wydarzeniami: lista postępu, przedmioty przywołujące i przepisy, łupy i kolekcja, rekordy walk, komunikaty o odejściu i radar bossów.
localizedSummaries.zh-Hans: 一本包含所有Boss、小Boss和事件的 Boss Log：进度清单、召唤物品与配方、战利品与收藏品、战斗记录、Boss离开提示以及Boss雷达。
用箭头指示屏幕外或远处 Boss 的方向，方便战斗时追踪目标。

manifest.name: Boss-Colored Relics
manifest.author: The Wise Willow
manifest.notes: Original resource pack by The Wise Willow

localizedSummaries.zh-Hans: 为 Boss 圣物赋予对应的色彩，采用重制版资源。

manifest.name: BunnySocial
manifest.author: VowTz
manifest.summary: Every vanity slot works like an accessory slot.
manifest.description: Items in the vanity (social) slots now apply their effects too, exactly as if they were in the matching equipment slot.

localizedSummaries.zh-Hans: 让每个时装栏也能发挥对应装备栏的效果。

manifest.name: ChestPeek
manifest.summary: Point at any container (chest, piggy bank, safe, forge, void vault) to see what is inside.

localizedSummaries.zh-Hans: 指向箱子、猪猪存钱罐、保险箱、护卫熔炉或虚空保险库，即可预览其中的物品。

manifest.name: Colored Damage Types
manifest.summary: Damage numbers and tooltips in the color of the weapon's class: melee, ranged, magic, summon, sentry, throwing and modded classes.

localizedSummaries.zh-Hans: 按近战、远程、魔法、召唤、哨兵、投掷和模组职业，为伤害数字与物品提示着色。

manifest.name: Consolaria Mobile
manifest.summary: Tons of exclusive content from the legacy and old-gen versions, reworked and rebalanced for modern Terraria.

localizedSummaries.zh-Hans: 让旧版移动端和主机版的独占内容回归，并针对现代泰拉瑞亚重新设计和平衡。

mods.name: Cooler Item Visual Effect — Bunny Port

manifest.name: Cooler Item Visual Effect — Bunny Port
manifest.summary: Efeito Slash Maneiro
manifest.description: efeito slash totalmente exagerado e bonito

localizedSummaries.zh-Hans: 夸张而华丽的挥砍特效，Bunny Loader 移植版。

manifest.name: Coyote Frames
manifest.summary: Mod that allows player to use Coyote frames that are presented in many other games.

authors.name: Gorffy, Ink of the Eternity, Litos the Litium

localizedSummaries.zh-Hans: 加入其他游戏中常见的离地宽限帧，让玩家离开平台边缘后仍有短暂的起跳机会。

manifest.name: Dark Fantasy Health/Mana
manifest.author: Santartica
manifest.description: Terraria Ovehaul for Health and Mana

localizedNames.zh-Hans: 暗黑奇幻生命与魔力界面

localizedSummaries.zh-Hans: 为生命值和魔力界面换上 Terraria Overhaul 风格的材质。

manifest.name: Default Dash
manifest.summary: Gives the player a basic dash without needing any dashing accessory.

localizedSummaries.zh-Hans: 无需装备冲刺饰品，也能使用基础冲刺。

manifest.name: Dev Tools
manifest.summary: 一个直观的工具界面：难度切换、实体清除、碰撞箱、天气与时间、相机与拍照模式、调试信息。

localizedSummaries.zh-Hans: 一个直观的工具界面：难度切换、实体清除、碰撞箱、天气与时间、相机与拍照模式、调试信息。

manifest.name: Directional Swings
manifest.summary: Melee swords swing toward where you aim, and the hitbox follows the blade.

localizedSummaries.zh-Hans: 近战剑朝瞄准方向挥动，攻击判定跟随剑刃。

manifest.name: Dobro de Dano
manifest.summary: Toda arma nasce com o dobro do dano.

localizedSummaries.zh-Hans: 让所有武器获得双倍基础伤害。

manifest.name: Don't Starve inspired NPC portraits
manifest.author: Fanec
manifest.description: Don't Starve inspired NPC portraits — port Bunny Loader.
manifest.notes: Original resource pack by Fanec. Texture assets retained with their original relative paths under content/Images.

localizedNames.zh-Hans: 饥荒风格 NPC 肖像

localizedSummaries.zh-Hans: 饥荒风格的 NPC 肖像资源包，Bunny Loader 移植版。

manifest.name: Flat Seed
manifest.summary: A secret seed for a world so flat you can run without fear of tripping into a hole: type "flat" when creating a world. Caves, biomes, structures and the floating islands stay as usual.

localizedSummaries.pt-BR: Uma seed secreta para um mundo tão plano que dá para correr sem medo de cair num buraco: digite "plano" ou "flat" ao criar um mundo. Cavernas, biomas, estruturas e as ilhas flutuantes continuam normais.
localizedSummaries.es-ES: Una semilla secreta para un mundo tan plano que puedes correr sin miedo a caer en un agujero: escribe "plano" o "flat" al crear un mundo. Las cuevas, los biomas, las estructuras y las islas flotantes siguen como siempre.
localizedSummaries.ru-RU: Секретный сид для мира настолько плоского, что можно бежать, не боясь провалиться в яму: введите «плоский» или «flat» при создании мира. Пещеры, биомы, постройки и парящие острова остаются как обычно.
localizedSummaries.zh-Hans: 一个平到可以放心狂奔、不怕掉进坑里的世界秘密种子：创建世界时输入「平坦」或「flat」。洞穴、生物群系、建筑和浮空岛照常保留。
localizedSummaries.vi-VN: Một hạt giống bí mật cho thế giới phẳng đến mức bạn có thể chạy mà không sợ rơi xuống hố: gõ "phẳng" hoặc "flat" khi tạo thế giới. Hang động, quần xã, công trình và đảo bay vẫn như bình thường.
localizedSummaries.th-TH: ซีดลับสำหรับโลกที่แบนจนวิ่งได้โดยไม่ต้องกลัวตกหลุม: พิมพ์ "แบน" หรือ "flat" ตอนสร้างโลก ถ้ำ ไบโอม สิ่งก่อสร้าง และเกาะลอยฟ้ายังคงเหมือนเดิม

manifest.name: Fonte Aclonica
manifest.author: Astigmatic
manifest.summary: Letras arredondadas e grossas, no estilo de cartaz de aventura

localizedSummaries.zh-Hans: 圆润粗厚的字形，具有冒险海报的风格。

manifest.name: Fonte Ale and Wenches
manifest.author: Nate Piekos (Blambot)
manifest.summary: Letra de taverna medieval, desenhada à mão

localizedSummaries.zh-Hans: 手绘风格的中世纪酒馆字体。

manifest.name: Fonte Comic Neue
manifest.summary: Troca as fontes do jogo pela Comic Neue, nítida em qualquer tela

localizedSummaries.zh-Hans: 将游戏字体替换为 Comic Neue，在不同屏幕上保持清晰。

manifest.name: Fonte Pescadero
manifest.author: Microsoft

authors.name: Mirasein
authors.role: 电脑版 Custom Fonts 资源包

manifest.summary: Serifada clássica, do resource pack Custom Fonts do PC

localizedSummaries.zh-Hans: 来自电脑版 Custom Fonts 资源包的经典衬线字体。

manifest.name: Fonte Ringbearer
manifest.author: Pete Klassen
manifest.summary: A letra do logotipo de O Senhor dos Anéis

localizedSummaries.zh-Hans: 采用《指环王》标志风格的字体。

manifest.name: Gnorp's Builder
manifest.summary: Gnorp, an alien builder town NPC, sells globes that instantly build houses, castles, arenas, elevators, pylons, lakes and minecart tracks where you tap.

localizedSummaries.pt-BR: Gnorp, um NPC construtor alienígena, vende globos que constroem na hora casas, castelos, arenas, elevadores, pilares, lagos e trilhos onde você toca.
localizedSummaries.es-ES: Gnorp, un constructor alienígena que vive en tu pueblo, vende globos que construyen al instante casas, castillos, arenas, ascensores, pilares, lagos y raíles de vagoneta donde tocas.
localizedSummaries.de-DE: Gnorp, ein außerirdischer Baumeister-NPC, verkauft Globen, die sofort Häuser, Burgen, Arenen, Aufzüge, Pylonen, Seen und Lorenschienen dort bauen, wo du tippst.
localizedSummaries.fr-FR: Gnorp, un PNJ bâtisseur extraterrestre, vend des globes qui construisent instantanément maisons, châteaux, arènes, ascenseurs, pylônes, lacs et rails de wagonnet là où tu touches.
localizedSummaries.it-IT: Gnorp, un PNG costruttore alieno, vende globi che costruiscono all'istante case, castelli, arene, ascensori, piloni, laghi e binari per carrello dove tocchi.
localizedSummaries.ru-RU: Гнорп, инопланетный житель-строитель, продаёт глобусы, которые мгновенно строят дома, замки, арены, лифты, пилоны, озёра и рельсы там, где вы коснётесь.
localizedSummaries.pl-PL: Gnorp, kosmiczny NPC budowniczy, sprzedaje kule, które natychmiast budują domy, zamki, areny, windy, pylony, jeziora i tory wagonika tam, gdzie dotkniesz.
localizedSummaries.zh-Hans: 外星建筑师城镇NPC Gnorp 出售建筑球，可以在你点击的位置立即建造房屋、城堡、竞技场、电梯、晶塔、湖泊和矿车轨道。

manifest.name: Gorilla
manifest.author: ported by Animatak
manifest.summary: Enfrente o Gorila. Talvez você precise de 100 homens para derrotar essa coisa... e não espere sair vivo.
manifest.description:
Enfrente o Gorila, um chefe ridiculamente poderoso e brutal. Talvez você precise de 100 homens para derrotar essa coisa... e mesmo assim, não espere sobreviver.
Mod original desenvolvido por GabeHasWon.

localizedSummaries.zh-Hans: 挑战强大而凶暴的大猩猩。也许需要一百个人才能打倒它……即便如此，也别指望能活下来。

manifest.name: Gravitation Don't Flip the Screen
manifest.summary: This mod makes the gravity inversion effect not flip your screen, only the player flips.

localizedSummaries.zh-Hans: 反转重力时只翻转角色，不翻转整个画面。

manifest.name: Improved Movement
manifest.summary: Your head follows the cursor, your body leans as you move, and slimes, zombies and critters lean too.

localizedSummaries.zh-Hans: 角色头部跟随光标、身体随移动倾斜；史莱姆、僵尸和小动物也会随动作倾斜。

manifest.name: Instant Platform Fallthrough
manifest.summary: Allows you to fall through platforms instantly while holding your down key instead of stopping for a moment.

localizedSummaries.zh-Hans: 按住向下键时立即穿过平台下落，不再短暂停顿。

manifest.name: Item Display Base
manifest.summary: A Display Base to show off any item, with glitter, outline and light effects. Made from marble or granite.

localizedSummaries.zh-Hans: 用大理石或花岗岩制作展示基座，展示任意物品，并添加闪烁、描边和照明效果。

manifest.name: Legendary Difficulty
manifest.summary: 为游戏添加自定义世界难度（原版只有普通/专家/大师/旅行难度），并加入传奇难度。.

localizedSummaries.zh-Hans: 为游戏添加自定义世界难度，并在原版普通、专家、大师和旅行难度之外加入传奇难度。

manifest.name: Lights And Shadows
manifest.summary: Sunlight, moonlight, shadow rays and bloom over the world, ported from the tModLoader mod and rebuilt to run on phones.

localizedSummaries.zh-Hans: 为世界添加日光、月光、光影射线和外发光，将 tModLoader 模组移植并调整为适合手机运行。

manifest.name: Loot Beams
manifest.summary: Borderlands-style light beams and glows in each dropped item's rarity color, with beam styles, glow and configurable lists.

localizedSummaries.zh-Hans: 为掉落物添加《无主之地》风格的稀有度彩色光柱与光晕，支持样式和筛选列表设置。

manifest.name: Minecraft Paintings
manifest.summary: Minecraft Paintings is a small-scale aesthetic content mod that adds all 30 paintings featured in Minecraft, manually recreated to include less noise and tile dimensions fitting Terraria paintings.

localizedSummaries.zh-Hans: 添加《我的世界》的 30 幅画作，手工重绘以减少杂点，并适配泰拉瑞亚的画作尺寸。

manifest.name: Minishark Turbo
manifest.summary: A Minishark vira uma metralhadora.

localizedSummaries.zh-Hans: 让迷你鲨化身高速机枪。

manifest.name: Mita NPC
manifest.summary: Four MiSide town NPCs with voiced dialogue, shops, weapons, pets and permanent combat manuals.

localizedSummaries.zh-Hans: 添加四位来自《米塔》（MiSide）的城镇 NPC，包含语音对话、商店、武器、宠物和永久战斗手册。

manifest.name: No Useless Pickups
manifest.summary: Consumable pickups (life hearts, mana stars, and Nebula boosters) can no longer be picked up if they are not needed.

localizedSummaries.zh-Hans: 不需要回复或增益时，不再拾取生命心、魔力星和星云强化焰等消耗性掉落物。

manifest.name: NPC Fall Damage
manifest.summary: This mod allows NPCs to take fall damage. Pretty self explanatory. This bonus also applies to bosses.

localizedSummaries.zh-Hans: 让 NPC 也会受到摔落伤害，Boss 同样适用。

manifest.name: NPC Unlock Announcer
manifest.summary: An RPG-style banner announces every Town NPC and town pet that moves into your world.

localizedSummaries.zh-Hans: 当城镇 NPC 或城镇宠物入住时，显示角色扮演游戏风格的公告横幅。

manifest.name: Overhealth
manifest.summary: Healing past full health becomes temporary Overhealth that absorbs damage and slowly decays.

localizedSummaries.zh-Hans: 超过生命上限的治疗量会转化为临时溢出生命值，用于吸收伤害，并随时间衰减。

manifest.name: Physaria (Kinetic Gore)
manifest.summary: A ragdoll and body physics engine for Terraria: enemies collapse into ragdolls, lose heads and limbs, bleed sticky blood, and humanoids and slimes wobble with physics. Purely cosmetic.

localizedSummaries.pt-BR: Um motor de ragdoll e física de corpos para o Terraria: inimigos caem como bonecos de pano, perdem a cabeça e as pernas, sangram sangue que gruda no chão, e humanoides e slimes balançam com física. Só visual.
localizedSummaries.es-ES: Un motor de ragdoll y física de cuerpos para Terraria: los enemigos caen como muñecos de trapo, pierden la cabeza y las piernas, sangran sangre que se pega al suelo, y humanoides y slimes se bambolean con física. Solo visual.
localizedSummaries.de-DE: Eine Ragdoll- und Körperphysik-Engine für Terraria: Gegner fallen als Ragdolls zusammen, verlieren Kopf und Beine, bluten klebriges Blut, und Humanoide und Schleime wackeln mit Physik. Rein kosmetisch.
localizedSummaries.fr-FR: Un moteur de ragdoll et de physique des corps pour Terraria : les ennemis s'effondrent en ragdolls, perdent tête et jambes, saignent un sang collant, et humanoïdes et slimes ballottent avec la physique. Purement cosmétique.
localizedSummaries.it-IT: Un motore di ragdoll e fisica dei corpi per Terraria: i nemici crollano come ragdoll, perdono testa e gambe, sanguinano sangue appiccicoso, e umanoidi e slime dondolano con la fisica. Puramente estetico.
localizedSummaries.ru-RU: Движок рэгдоллов и физики тел для Terraria: враги падают рэгдоллами, теряют голову и ноги, истекают липкой кровью, а гуманоиды и слизни качаются по физике. Чисто косметический.
localizedSummaries.pl-PL: Silnik ragdolli i fizyki ciał dla Terrarii: wrogowie padają jako ragdolle, tracą głowę i nogi, krwawią lepką krwią, a humanoidy i szlamy chwieją się z fizyką. Czysto kosmetyczny.
localizedSummaries.zh-Hans: 泰拉瑞亚的布娃娃与身体物理引擎：敌人倒下变成布娃娃，会掉头断腿、流出粘性血液，人形角色和史莱姆会随物理摇晃。纯外观效果。

manifest.name: Player Ping UI
manifest.summary: See your ping in multiplayer, pick an icon style that everyone sees, and open a panel with the ping of every connected player.

localizedSummaries.pt-BR: Veja seu ping no multijogador, escolha um estilo de ícone que todos veem e abra um painel com o ping de cada jogador conectado.
localizedSummaries.es-ES: Mira tu ping en multijugador, elige un estilo de icono que todos ven y abre un panel con el ping de cada jugador conectado.
localizedSummaries.de-DE: Sieh deinen Ping im Mehrspieler, wähle einen Symbolstil, den alle sehen, und öffne ein Fenster mit dem Ping jedes verbundenen Spielers.
localizedSummaries.fr-FR: Vois ton ping en multijoueur, choisis un style d'icône visible par tous et ouvre un panneau avec le ping de chaque joueur connecté.
localizedSummaries.it-IT: Guarda il tuo ping in multigiocatore, scegli uno stile d'icona che vedono tutti e apri un pannello con il ping di ogni giocatore connesso.
localizedSummaries.ru-RU: Смотрите свой пинг в мультиплеере, выберите стиль значка, который видят все, и откройте панель с пингом каждого подключённого игрока.
localizedSummaries.pl-PL: Zobacz swój ping w trybie wieloosobowym, wybierz styl ikony widoczny dla wszystkich i otwórz panel z pingiem każdego połączonego gracza.
localizedSummaries.zh-Hans: 在多人游戏中查看你的延迟，选择所有人都能看到的图标样式，并打开显示每位已连接玩家延迟的面板。

manifest.name: Quality of Bunny
manifest.summary: Quality-of-life tweaks, every one a toggle in Mod Configuration.

localizedSummaries.zh-Hans: 提供多项便利性改进，每项都可在模组配置中单独开关。

manifest.name: Resized Frames
manifest.summary: Items placed in frames will be drawn at their actual size

localizedSummaries.zh-Hans: 让物品框中的物品按实际尺寸显示。

manifest.name: Sem Dano de Queda
manifest.summary: Cair de qualquer altura deixou de doer.

localizedSummaries.zh-Hans: 从任意高度跌落都不会受到摔落伤害。

manifest.name: Shared Inventory
manifest.summary: On multiplayer, the host's inventory, armor, pets and life/mana are shared with everyone.

localizedSummaries.zh-Hans: 多人游戏中，所有玩家共享房主的背包、装备、宠物、生命值和魔力值。

manifest.name: Teleport Keeper
manifest.summary: Create teleports with a name and a biome icon, organize them in a list with search, favorites and filters, and travel to them from the map. When you die, a way back that is only yours.

localizedSummaries.pt-BR: Crie teleportes com nome e ícone do bioma, organize-os numa lista com busca, favoritos e filtros, e viaje até eles pelo mapa. Ao morrer, um ponto de volta só seu.
localizedSummaries.es-ES: Crea teletransportes con nombre e icono del bioma, organízalos en una lista con búsqueda, favoritos y filtros, y viaja hasta ellos desde el mapa. Al morir, un punto de regreso solo tuyo.
localizedSummaries.ru-RU: Создавайте телепорты с названием и значком биома, держите их в списке с поиском, избранным и фильтрами и перемещайтесь к ним через карту. После смерти — точка возврата только для вас.
localizedSummaries.zh-Hans: 创建带名称和生物群系图标的传送点，在支持搜索、收藏和筛选的列表中管理它们，并通过地图传送过去。死亡后，还有一个只属于你的返回点。
localizedSummaries.vi-VN: Tạo điểm dịch chuyển có tên và biểu tượng quần xã, sắp xếp trong danh sách có tìm kiếm, yêu thích và bộ lọc, rồi đi đến chúng từ bản đồ. Khi chết, có một điểm quay lại chỉ của riêng bạn.
localizedSummaries.th-TH: สร้างจุดวาร์ปพร้อมชื่อและไอคอนไบโอม จัดเก็บในรายการที่มีการค้นหา รายการโปรด และตัวกรอง แล้วเดินทางไปจากแผนที่ เมื่อตาย จะมีจุดกลับที่เป็นของคุณคนเดียว

manifest.name: Templo Pirâmide
manifest.author: Cortex
manifest.summary: Uma pirâmide Lihzahrd com andares distantes, câmaras e um grande salão para o Golem.

localizedSummaries.zh-Hans: 将丛林蜥蜴神庙改造成层间距宽阔、带有多个房间及石巨人大厅的金字塔。

manifest.name: Terrarchitect
manifest.summary: Terrarchitect is a furniture / build mod that adds a wide variety of custom-made, high-quality decorational items and blocks to Terraria! It also aims to make some previously ubobtainable or unplacable vanilla items available.

localizedSummaries.zh-Hans: 添加大量精细的家具、装饰物和方块，并让部分原本无法获取或放置的原版物品可以使用。

manifest.name: Terraria Tethers
manifest.summary: Players are tied together by a rope and have to cooperate.

localizedSummaries.zh-Hans: 用绳索把玩家连接起来，必须互相配合才能行动。

manifest.name: Tooltip Icon
manifest.summary: Adds a small icon to the left of each item tooltip line: damage, speed, defense, tool power, potions, prefixes and more.

localizedSummaries.zh-Hans: 为伤害、速度、防御、工具能力、药水、修饰语等物品提示行添加小图标。

manifest.name: Top-Down Mode (teste)
manifest.summary: Teste top-down: sem gravidade, 8 direções, golpe na direção do mouse e mundo top-down em ilha com os biomas do Terraria.
manifest.description: VERSÃO BETA: este mod ainda não está completo e pode ter erros, bugs e comportamentos inesperados. Use por sua conta e risco e, de preferência, em mundos de teste (faça backup dos seus saves). O Top-Down Mode transforma o Terraria em um jogo de visão de cima: sem gravidade, com movimento em 8 direções, golpe de espada na direção do mouse, mundos novos gerados como ilha com os biomas do Terraria (rios, lagos, árvores, cactos, pedras e mato), água em movimento com nado, ciclo de dia e noite, profundidade (y-sort) de árvores, móveis e NPCs, e cavernas com minérios acessadas por escada. Novidades ainda estão sendo adicionadas e alguns sistemas podem mudar nas próximas versões.

localizedSummaries.zh-Hans: 无重力、八方向移动、朝光标方向挥砍，并生成包含泰拉瑞亚生物群系的俯视角岛屿世界。

manifest.name: Touhou Pets
manifest.summary: Adventure with cute partners: 19 Touhou characters as pets, dropped by the bosses. They animate, react to the world and talk to you and to each other.

localizedSummaries.zh-Hans: 19 位东方角色化身宠物，由 Boss 掉落；她们拥有动画，会回应周围环境，并与玩家或其他伙伴交谈。

manifest.name: TownNPC Home
manifest.summary: Teleporta NPCs de cidade para suas casas.

localizedSummaries.zh-Hans: 将城镇 NPC 传送回各自的住所。

manifest.name: Universal Map
manifest.summary: In multiplayer, every player's explored map is shared with everyone every minute.

localizedSummaries.pt-BR: No multijogador, o mapa explorado de cada jogador é compartilhado com todos a cada minuto.
localizedSummaries.es-ES: En multijugador, el mapa explorado de cada jugador se comparte con todos cada minuto.
localizedSummaries.de-DE: Im Mehrspieler wird die erkundete Karte jedes Spielers jede Minute mit allen geteilt.
localizedSummaries.fr-FR: En multijoueur, la carte explorée de chaque joueur est partagée avec tout le monde chaque minute.
localizedSummaries.it-IT: In multigiocatore, la mappa esplorata di ogni giocatore viene condivisa con tutti ogni minuto.
localizedSummaries.ru-RU: В мультиплеере исследованная карта каждого игрока каждую минуту передаётся всем.
localizedSummaries.pl-PL: W trybie wieloosobowym odkryta mapa każdego gracza jest co minutę udostępniana wszystkim.
localizedSummaries.zh-Hans: 在多人游戏中，每位玩家探索过的地图每分钟都会与所有人共享。

manifest.name: Vein Miner
manifest.summary: Break one ore with your pickaxe and the whole vein comes with it. Add any block with /vein add.

localizedSummaries.zh-Hans: 用镐敲掉一块矿石，即可连同整条矿脉一起挖掘；使用 /vein add 可添加其他方块。

manifest.name: Vida Cheia
manifest.summary: Você não morre

localizedSummaries.zh-Hans: 让角色不会死亡。

manifest.name: Weapon Out Lite
manifest.summary: Shows the held item on your character: swords at the waist, weapons on the back, bows, books and staves in their own poses, and combat poses after attacking.

localizedSummaries.zh-Hans: 在角色身上展示当前手持物品：腰间的剑、背负的武器，以及弓、书和法杖的专属姿势，并加入攻击后的战斗姿势。

manifest.name: Which Mod Is This From?
manifest.summary: When you look at a modded item, block or NPC, WMITF will show you the name of the mod which it came from.

localizedSummaries.zh-Hans: 查看模组物品、方块或 NPC 时，显示它们所属的模组名称。

manifest.name: Wikithis
manifest.summary: Allows you to check the item wiki from within the game.

localizedSummaries.zh-Hans: 直接在游戏中查询物品的 Wiki 页面。

manifest.name: Wild and Horned

authors.name: MineGame223 and Group For One
authors.role: Touhou Little Friend 框架与像素图基础

authors.name: Potato
authors.role: Bunny Loader 移植与巴西葡萄牙语本地化

manifest.summary: Sixteen animated Touhou companions with conversations, seven light pets, crafting recipes and Kasen's oni transformations.

localizedSummaries.zh-Hans: 添加 16 位带动画与对话的东方伙伴、7 位照明宠物、合成配方，以及茨木华扇的鬼形态变身。

manifest.name: WorldGen Previewer
manifest.summary: Watch your world being generated: a live map filled column by column, pause, skip or repeat steps, or cancel the generation.

localizedSummaries.pt-BR: Veja o seu mundo sendo gerado: um mapa ao vivo preenchido coluna por coluna, pause, pule ou repita etapas, ou cancele a geração.
localizedSummaries.es-ES: Mira cómo se genera tu mundo: un mapa en vivo que se rellena columna a columna, pausa, salta o repite pasos, o cancela la generación.
localizedSummaries.fr-FR: Regardez votre monde se générer : une carte en direct remplie colonne par colonne, mettez en pause, ignorez ou répétez des étapes, ou annulez la génération.
localizedSummaries.de-DE: Sieh zu, wie deine Welt generiert wird: eine Live-Karte, die Spalte für Spalte gefüllt wird; pausiere, überspringe oder wiederhole Schritte oder brich die Generierung ab.
localizedSummaries.it-IT: Guarda il tuo mondo mentre viene generato: una mappa dal vivo riempita colonna per colonna, metti in pausa, salta o ripeti i passaggi, o annulla la generazione.
localizedSummaries.ru-RU: Смотрите, как генерируется ваш мир: живая карта, заполняемая столбец за столбцом; ставьте на паузу, пропускайте или повторяйте этапы, или отмените генерацию.
localizedSummaries.zh-Hans: 观看世界的生成过程：逐列填充的实时地图，可暂停、跳过或重复步骤，也可取消生成。
localizedSummaries.pl-PL: Patrz, jak generuje się twój świat: mapa na żywo wypełniana kolumna po kolumnie; wstrzymuj, pomijaj lub powtarzaj etapy albo anuluj generowanie.

manifest.name: Zoom Tweaks
manifest.summary: Zoom enhancements

localizedSummaries.zh-Hans: 增强游戏画面的缩放功能。

manifest.name: 愿者上钩 (VoluntaryHook)
manifest.summary: 抛出鱼钩后数量固定 5 倍，实现多倍鱼钩。

localizedSummaries.zh-Hans: 抛出鱼钩后，鱼钩数量固定为五倍。

manifest.name: 灾厄Boss外观
manifest.author: 令狐e
manifest.description: 将毁灭者-神明吞噬者，双子魔眼-XS-01阿尔忒弥斯和XS-03阿波罗,机械骷髅王-XF-09阿瑞斯

localizedSummaries.zh-Hans: 将机械三王替换为灾厄风格外观；修复两张弹幕图片编码错误。原作者：令狐e。

manifest.name: Ghastling as Abigail
manifest.author: Pixivic
manifest.description: 将阿比盖尔替换为萌萌恶魂外观，并替换召唤物品、增益图标和花朵贴图。当前版本仅应用图片，PC 音效和名称替换暂不生效。

localizedSummaries.zh-Hans: 阿比盖尔与相关物品的萌萌恶魂外观；原作者 Pixivic，移植者流脌。仅图片替换。
